description:
Extend the expiration time of a pending verification request.

ACCESS: needs a Proof account. Authenticate this client (Claude Code: /mcp → Authenticate), or sign in with start_login — a session opens this tool — then call this tool again.

extends_by_hours.description: Hours from now until the request expires, 1–720 (default: 168, i.e. 7 days). An expired request is reactivated.

name: extend_request

message.description: `Verification request extended`, or `Verification request reactivated and extended` for a request that had expired (its `status` is then `pending` or `partial` again)
